# Stainless & Food Equipment

Stainless equipment for food and pharmaceutical use needs uniform, cleanable surfaces. Non-woven abrasives produce consistent satin and hairline finishes and remove weld discoloration.

<!-- TODO: 補上實際客戶案例 -->

## Recommended products

- [Buffing & Polishing Wheels](https://arsen-industrial.com/products/buffing-wheels.md): Airway, bias and stitched buffing wheels for cutting and colouring with polishing compounds.
- [Flap Discs](https://arsen-industrial.com/products/flap-discs.md): Flap discs for angle grinders that grind and finish in one step on welds, edges and flat surfaces.
- [Non-Woven Wheels](https://arsen-industrial.com/products/non-woven-wheels.md): Non-woven surface conditioning wheels for deburring, blending and satin finishing without changing part geometry.
